_comment: The NitroDrp logo: a NOS bottle carrying an upload arrow, on an orange plate. 24 x 24, one letter per pixel, "." is transparent. P is the plate; o is the arrow (the same orange, kept separate so the bottle can be used without the plate). v is the little sparkle on the plate, also kept apart so it stays out of the bottle-only version. Everything else is generated from this file: the favicon, the phone icons (dev/make-icons.py) and the header logo (web/src/lib/logo.ts).
